name: Tam huu
summary: Tam hữu is a Trà Quế roll on the 16 Apr 2024 Da Nang page: one cooked land shrimp, a slice of boiled pork, and a stalk of mint, tied with a blanched scallion leaf and dipped in sweet-sour fish sauce.
origin: Trà Quế vegetable village, Hội An, on the 16 Apr 2024 city page.
taste: The page names the mint, the scallion, the fatty belly pork, and the sweet shrimp.
howToEat: Eat one roll with the sweet-sour fish sauce. The page says the three parts are shrimp, pork, and the herb.
where: Trà Quế, Hội An. The 16 Apr 2024 page does not name a house. Check on arrival.
